task.title: Page one-shot schedules sparsely by status
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/993 with bounded exact-ID scan pages filtered by persisted one-shot schedule status.
acceptance_criteria: Inspect at most one positive at-most-1024 schedule window plus lookahead and return complete exact-status matches in exact-ID order.
Advance continuation from the last inspected schedule even when no schedule matches.
Fail closed on selected or lookahead corruption while isolating evidence outside the bounded window.

attempts.diagnostic: Targeted store tests failed because ScheduleStatusPage and ScheduleStore::list_by_status_page did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added focused tests for sparse matches, all-nonmatching progress, exact ordering, cursors, empty storage, and corruption boundaries.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded kernel slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented bounded authoritative-stream selection, canonical selected-window replay, exact persisted-status filtering, and last-inspected continuation.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 993 in crates/vela-kernel/src/scheduler.rs with store tests, ADR-0095, and scheduler documentation; independent review prompted additional ordering coverage.

attempts.diagnostic: A review-limit false green was excluded; after cooldown, CodeRabbit command eab23ce7 completed on exact head 1435534 with no actionable comments and zero unresolved threads.
attempts.patch: Preserved the verified head and armed squash merge only after the Rust gate and genuine review completed.

outcome.summary: Issue 993 delivered bounded sparse schedule status paging without adding lifecycle or execution authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 994 exact head 1435534dc53e04bbdf97f9d0bcb42cfa5687ba0f

lessons: Sparse filtering must advance from the last inspected ID rather than the last emitted match so empty pages cannot stall.
The lookahead must be canonically replayed before it can prove continuation; corruption beyond that bounded window remains isolated.
The projection reads persisted status only and adds no clock, cursor persistence, mutation, dispatch, permission, or execution authority.
